name: Malicious Mandibles
body:
Your natural aberrant heritage allows you to spout a gnashing mouth, like a true mimic, and with time a hideous double mouth.

Prerequisite(s): Mimicman, Mimic Object ability

Benefit(s): You gain a 1d6 bite attack while using your mimic object ability.

Special: If you have 5 or more HD you may use your mimic object ability as an immediate action, if you have 10 or more HD you gain an additional bite attack and the damage on each of them improves to a D8.
